cases.title: Repeated short predicate remains clearer at the call site
cases.fixture: A private helper used three times only returns field != null && Catalog.isReference(field.getCode(), field.getPath()). The changed call sites rely on its null behavior.
expected_decisions: Compare the helper with the expression written at each changed call site
Recommend the direct expression when it keeps the branch compact and exposes null and field semantics
Treat reuse count as duplication cost rather than proof that the helper should remain
disallowed_decisions: Keep the helper solely because it has multiple callers
Require a JavaDoc as the primary fix for the hidden predicate

cases.title: A short classifier makes the encoding decision easier to read
cases.fixture: A changed caller uses isXmlContentType(type) to choose an XML encoder. The private helper returns false for null, then combines application/xml compatibility, text/xml compatibility, and +xml suffix recognition. A second helper isJsonContentType(type) combines JSON compatibility and +json suffix recognition in two lines; its caller checks null first. Each helper has one caller.
expected_decisions: Allow both helpers to remain because they compose a coherent classification used by the caller
Compare readability in the real encoding decision rather than using line count or reuse count
Require concise documentation of recognition scope and the differing null contracts when absent
Preserve existing matching and null behavior
disallowed_decisions: Require expansion solely because a helper has two lines, a single expression, or one caller
Treat any is-prefixed method or multiple boolean operators as sufficient justification
Create a shared utility solely because both helpers can remain

cases.title: A null-safe field traversal adds no independent selection rule
cases.fixture: resolveRequestBodySchema(schema) has one caller and only returns null if schema or schema.getRequest() is null, otherwise schema.getRequest().getBody(). The caller uses the result to build a request; there are no implicit callers or other selection rules.
expected_decisions: Recommend writing the null checks and field read at the caller because the data source and absence behavior become directly visible
Preserve null results for both missing schema and missing request
Distinguish this traversal from a helper that composes protocol-recognition rules
disallowed_decisions: Keep the helper solely by labeling field traversal a resolution contract
Treat one caller or short length as the deciding reason
Remove the null checks

cases.title: Multiple conditions do not automatically form a useful abstraction
cases.fixture: A changed branch calls isOrderProcessable(order), which combines an ownership check and a shipment-state check. A false result always throws Invalid order. Existing caller requirements distinguish permission denial from already-shipped conflict and give different recovery actions.
expected_decisions: Reject the combined boolean boundary because the caller needs the distinct failure reasons
Preserve separate permission and state errors with their respective recovery actions
disallowed_decisions: Approve the helper merely because it combines multiple checks under a business-sounding name
Replace the distinct failures with a generic false result and message

cases.title: Adjacent calls with different responsibilities need separate intent comments
cases.fixture: One call maps and validates a request for the next processor. The following call performs remote business execution. A single comment currently covers both calls.
expected_decisions: Treat mapping and remote execution as separate stages
Require each stage comment to explain its own handoff, ordering, or failure consequence
disallowed_decisions: Accept one comment merely because both calls use the same receiver

cases.title: A comment should not center an irrelevant historical input
cases.fixture: A changed encoder-selection comment says only the resolved content type selects the encoder and legacyFormat does not participate. The legacy field no longer exists in the current contract, data, or compatibility path.
expected_decisions: Rewrite the comment from the positive current encoder-selection rule
Remove the legacyFormat comparison because a reader without the change history does not need it
disallowed_decisions: Keep the historical comparison merely because it is factually true
Ban all negative wording regardless of current contract relevance

cases.title: A real compatibility role remains in the current comment
cases.fixture: A legacyFormat field is still accepted when reading stored configurations, but runtime encoder selection uses the resolved content type. Removing the compatibility fact would make the surviving field appear unused and safe to delete.
expected_decisions: State the positive current encoder-selection rule
Retain legacyFormat in the comment and explain its present stored-configuration compatibility role
disallowed_decisions: Remove every mention of legacyFormat solely to avoid historical framing
Say only that legacyFormat does not participate without explaining why it still exists

cases.title: Map construction must expose duplicate selection policy
cases.fixture: MongoDB returns active schemas without an explicit sort. The code uses putIfAbsent(schema.getApiCode(), schema) and names the result schemasByApiCodeMap.
expected_decisions: Identify nondeterministic first-record selection when duplicate active schemas exist
Require uniqueness validation or a stable ordering and a name that exposes first-record policy
disallowed_decisions: Treat putIfAbsent as a complete duplicate policy
Approve the generic map name without explaining selection semantics

cases.title: Structured provider rejection cannot be erased
cases.fixture: A successful HTTP response contains Error=true and ErrorMessage. The code logs only BUSINESS_REJECTED and throws Remote call failed. No repository mapping table or disclosure contract is found.
expected_decisions: Report that the only provider diagnostic detail has been lost
Keep business rejection distinct from transport and parsing failures
Present caller exposure, internal retention, and an explicit provider failure type as options because mapping evidence is absent
disallowed_decisions: Invent a local error mapping from message similarity
Require unconditional raw provider-message exposure
Treat the structured business error as an exception message

cases.title: Complete safe infrastructure logging should not be duplicated
cases.fixture: A repository interceptor already records the operation, masked request fields, response status, provider error, request ID, elapsed time, retry outcome, and the final exception once in production.
expected_decisions: Reuse the existing diagnostic owner
Add business-layer logging only if a concrete investigation field is still missing
disallowed_decisions: Always print request and response again in the service
Add catch-log-throw at every layer

cases.title: Fallback catch explains the changed guarantee locally
cases.fixture: A catch for fingerprint generation returns a direct AUTH API result without pending cache-write state. The try block has a comment, but the catch has no local comment.
expected_decisions: Require a catch-local comment before the fallback return
Explain the failed operation, direct AUTH path, and skipped cache-write guarantee
disallowed_decisions: Accept the try-block comment or log text as a replacement
Require comments for transparent direct rethrows

cases.title: Clear method name does not remove an independent action contract
cases.fixture: A private method named captureFinalHttpRequestPayload performs one linear independent lifecycle action and has no JavaDoc.
expected_decisions: Require JavaDoc because the method owns an independent processing or lifecycle action
Describe the contract information not visible from the name instead of restating the method name
disallowed_decisions: Exempt the method solely because its name is clear and its body is linear

cases.title: A local branch does not justify a design pattern
cases.fixture: The task adds one local if branch for a second implementation. Selection occurs in one place and both branches remain short with no shared workflow duplication.
expected_decisions: Keep the direct branch because a new structure has no material current benefit
Continue without pausing for a design-pattern choice
disallowed_decisions: Add an interface and factory only because a second implementation exists
Report the direct branch as a quality finding

cases.title: Conflicting public-contract evidence must be surfaced
cases.fixture: A published API document requires NOT_FOUND, an executable test expects INVALID_ARGUMENT, and current source returns a generic failure. The requested change touches this response contract.
expected_decisions: Report the conflict among authority, test, and observed source behavior
Explain the caller compatibility impact and request a decision before changing the contract
disallowed_decisions: Choose the test automatically because it is executable
Choose the most common nearby pattern without reporting the conflict

cases.title: Verification follows the final tool-modified state
cases.fixture: The initial patch passes review. A formatter and Git hook then rewrite imports, comments, and one generated Java file before completion.
expected_decisions: Reread repository status, the final diff, and all affected files after the tools finish
Include the generated file, recompute triggered references, and rerun invalidated checks
Report only checks that apply to the observed final state
disallowed_decisions: Reuse the pre-hook review as final verification
Treat a successful hook exit code as proof that semantic checks passed

cases.title: A named field is only the start of impact analysis
cases.fixture: The task asks to change field A. Field B does not reference A, but validation, mapping, and one diagnostic event use A and B together to represent one business state.
expected_decisions: Trace field A through its sources, transformations, consumers, diagnostics, and tests
Recognize field B and the shared business invariant as part of the semantic neighborhood
Explicitly decide whether field B and each joint use change or remain valid
disallowed_decisions: Limit the change analysis to textual references of field A
Ignore field B solely because the request did not name it

cases.title: An unexplained legacy log requires evidence before alteration
cases.fixture: A legacy failure log records fields A and B. Current callers, tests, configuration, comments, and comparable code do not explain why both are present. Removing B may reduce production incident diagnosis.
expected_decisions: Inspect focused Git history because current repository evidence cannot explain the diagnostic field
If the purpose remains unresolved, pause with the evidence checked, exact ambiguity, options, effects, and a recommendation
Preserve the existing diagnostic capability until the material ambiguity is resolved
disallowed_decisions: Remove field B solely because it was not named in the request
Ask only a broad question about the business logic
Read the entire module history without a focused reason

cases.title: Sufficient repository evidence avoids unnecessary questions
cases.fixture: A caller, an integration test, and the logging wrapper contract show that fields A and B correlate a failed request with its resolved owner. The requested representation change to A does not alter B or that correlation.
expected_decisions: Use the caller, test, and logging contract to establish the diagnostic purpose
Preserve the A and B correlation while applying the representation change
Continue without asking the user because the repository evidence resolves the decision
disallowed_decisions: Pause merely because the log is old
Require Git history after current evidence already establishes the contract

cases.title: A local rename does not require broad impact analysis
cases.fixture: A private local variable is renamed for clarity. Its initializer, uses, enclosing method, and focused tests show no behavior, contract, data-flow, or diagnostic change.
expected_decisions: Use the enclosing method and focused references to confirm the rename is behavior-neutral
Keep the investigation and change local
Continue without asking the user or reading Git history
disallowed_decisions: Read the entire module before renaming the local variable
Report unrelated historical code
Ask the user to explain business behavior that the rename does not affect

cases.title: Missing local guidance is offered once without blocking work
cases.fixture: A confirmed Git repository has no .codex/project-guidance.md. The user asks for a substantive Java implementation and declines the offer to initialize local guidance.
expected_decisions: Ask once whether to initialize the local guidance file
Continue with normal targeted repository discovery after the user declines
Do not ask again during the same task
disallowed_decisions: Create the file or alter Git exclusions without approval
Block the implementation because optional guidance is absent

cases.title: Current logging guidance narrows discovery without becoming proof
cases.fixture: The relevant Logging hint names the preferred project logger. Its verified commit is an ancestor of the Git-check local baseline, no invalidating build or logging infrastructure path changed, and the affected class uses that logger nearby.
expected_decisions: Use the Logging hint to avoid a repository-wide logging-framework scan
Confirm applicability at the affected class or boundary before using the logger
Treat the hint as advisory rather than a repository rule
disallowed_decisions: Load every project-guidance section
Report another logger as a finding based only on the hint

cases.title: Utility guidance prompts reuse only after API verification
cases.fixture: Dependencies And Utilities suggests checking an approved utility family before writing common conversion code. Current build evidence includes the dependency and the task needs such a conversion.
expected_decisions: Inspect the dependency version and actual utility API relevant to the conversion
Reuse the existing utility when its verified behavior matches the task
Keep a direct implementation when the utility contract does not fit
disallowed_decisions: Call a guessed utility method based only on the guidance
Build a duplicate helper without checking the named utility family

cases.title: Current repository evidence overrides local guidance
cases.fixture: Local guidance recommends client A, but the current build configuration removed A and the affected module, tests, and formal repository instructions require client B.
expected_decisions: Follow the current repository instructions and verified client B contract
Treat the local hint as outdated and explain the material conflict
Ask before refreshing the local guidance
disallowed_decisions: Reintroduce client A because the local file names it
Treat the local file as equal to formal repository instructions

cases.title: A local formatting hint does not create a quality finding
cases.fixture: Formatting And Naming prefers one wrapping style, while the changed Java code follows the repository formatter and violates no formal instruction or deterministic Skill rule.
expected_decisions: Treat the wrapping preference as optional local guidance
Accept the formatter-compliant code without a P2 or P3 finding
disallowed_decisions: Report a style violation solely from project-guidance.md
Describe the hint as a repository-wide mandatory convention

cases.title: Stale guidance triggers targeted verification
cases.fixture: The guidance verified commit is missing, not an ancestor, or followed by Maven or Gradle dependency changes. The task adds a remote call and needs logging and client choices.
expected_decisions: Treat the relevant dependency, logging, remote-call, and build hints as unverified
Inspect the changed descriptors, current remote-call infrastructure, and a representative use
Avoid scanning unrelated modules or loading unrelated guidance sections
disallowed_decisions: Trust the stale client and logging hints
Discard every hint and rescan the entire repository

cases.title: Local guidance excludes code snapshots
cases.fixture: During initialization, repository exploration reveals current modules, class paths, dependency versions, call relationships, and a stable preference to check the shared utility family first.
expected_decisions: Record only the stable utility preference as an advisory starting point
Keep modules, class paths, versions, and call relationships out of the local file
Direct enforceable requirements to AGENTS.md or formal project documentation
disallowed_decisions: Generate a repository structure or symbol snapshot in project-guidance.md
Present discovered source layout as a durable instruction

cases.title: Uncommitted infrastructure changes prevent baseline advancement
cases.fixture: Targeted verification establishes the new logging choice, but the relevant pom.xml and logging configuration changes are still uncommitted. The user has not yet approved a guidance refresh.
expected_decisions: Use current worktree evidence for the code task
Do not update the guidance or advance verified_commit without approval
Explain that the baseline cannot advance while relevant configuration remains uncommitted
disallowed_decisions: Set verified_commit to HEAD as if it included the uncommitted configuration
Silently rewrite the local guidance

cases.title: Refreshing one guidance section does not refresh the others
cases.prompt: 核实日志框架提示后，只刷新 Logging 章节
cases.fixture: A schema_version 2 project-guidance file has separate verified_commits. Logging was rechecked at the current local baseline, while Dependencies And Utilities was not inspected.
expected_decisions: Update only the Logging verified commit after approval
Leave Dependencies And Utilities at its previous commit or unverified
Do not treat one section refresh as proof for all sections
disallowed_decisions: Copy the Logging commit into every section
Refresh metadata without user approval
assertions: The answer names the independently refreshed section
The answer preserves the unverified state of untouched sections

cases.title: An ignored path can still be tracked
cases.prompt: 初始化项目提示文件并登记到 Git 本地排除
cases.fixture: git check-ignore --no-index matches .codex/project-guidance.md, but git ls-files also reports the path because it was committed previously.
expected_decisions: Recognize that the path is tracked despite matching an exclude rule
Stop automatic local-only registration and tell the user the conflict
Do not silently create or refresh the file
disallowed_decisions: Treat check-ignore alone as proof that the file is untracked
Modify .gitignore automatically
assertions: The answer distinguishes ignore matching from index tracking

cases.title: A local rename does not prompt for project guidance
cases.prompt: 只重命名一个局部变量，不改变行为
cases.fixture: The repository has no project-guidance.md. The task changes one private local variable name and does not touch logging, dependencies, remote calls, exceptions, or build verification.
expected_decisions: Keep the project-guidance initialization prompt silent
Use focused local evidence and complete the rename
disallowed_decisions: Ask to initialize project guidance merely because the file is absent
Scan the whole repository
assertions: The answer does not ask for project-guidance initialization

cases.title: A local baseline with unknown remote freshness cannot refresh hints
cases.prompt: 在远端不可访问但本地有改动时完成 Java 实现
cases.fixture: The Git check reports a dirty related worktree and remote unavailable, but emits the current local SHA. The task uses current source evidence and does not need to publish changes.
expected_decisions: Use the local SHA as a reading baseline with remoteFreshness unconfirmed
Continue only related work while respecting the dirty-worktree warning
Do not advance project-guidance verified commits
disallowed_decisions: Claim that the remote is current
Refresh project guidance as if the baseline were remotely confirmed
assertions: The answer separately reports local baseline and remote freshness

cases.title: Literal flag sequences require call-site meaning review
cases.prompt: 检查这个新增调用是否容易理解：validateNode(node, false, true, false)
cases.fixture: An application validator accepts flags for a fixed document region, root identity, and ancestor state. Several changed entry calls pass adjacent boolean literals with no readable indication of their separate meaning.
expected_decisions: Identify the different responsibilities of the flags at the call site
Consider removing invariant parameters or a lightweight named location while keeping true traversal state separate
Use P3 for reading cost alone and impact-based severity when swapped flags can change validation
disallowed_decisions: Approve the call solely because parameter JavaDoc exists
Ban every boolean parameter or create a carrier solely from the flag count
assertions: The review explains what meaning is hidden rather than counting true and false values

cases.title: Readable dynamic booleans and required interfaces can remain
cases.prompt: 检查是否需要替换这些布尔参数：setEnabled(true)、walk(child, inheritedEnabled)、vendorClient.setOption(false)
cases.fixture: setEnabled is an existing obvious switch. inheritedEnabled is dynamic ancestor-derived state needed by recursion. vendorClient implements a fixed third-party API; a framework callback also has a required boolean parameter.
expected_decisions: Keep the obvious switch and required third-party and framework signatures
Preserve named dynamic traversal state when deriving it from the child would change behavior
disallowed_decisions: Add wrappers or enums only to eliminate all booleans
Treat constant arguments to an external signature as removable parameters
assertions: The proposal retains legitimate boolean uses without wrapper proliferation

cases.title: Invariant application-controlled parameters have no speculative extension exemption
cases.fixture: Every relevant caller passes request.body to a private request-only validator. There are no implicit callers, external signature contracts, or current requirements for other paths. A separate recursive method carries genuinely changing descendant paths.
expected_decisions: Remove the invariant entry parameter and keep the fixed value at its owner
Retain the changing recursive path and preserve diagnostics
disallowed_decisions: Keep the invariant parameter for possible future reuse
Replace a fixed string with a fixed enum parameter without reducing redundancy
Remove the recursive path merely because the entry path is constant
assertions: The design distinguishes the invariant entry value from dynamic descendant values

cases.title: Object properties cannot replace distinct invocation or traversal context
cases.prompt: 用节点属性替换校验参数，并减少祖先状态传递
cases.fixture: The same tree-node type can occur in request headers or body. A parent conversion flag clears child flags before a later attributes check, so the child's current flag cannot identify whether it is inside a converted subtree. Arrays and nested objects participate in cleanup.
expected_decisions: Keep fixed invocation location separate from node-owned properties
Preserve ancestor semantics explicitly or use an equivalent subtree traversal
Verify root and array boundaries, cleanup, validation order, null handling, error category and message
disallowed_decisions: Add header or body location to the reusable node only to avoid a parameter
Infer converted-subtree state from the cleared child flag
Claim equivalence solely from the final serialized tree
assertions: The plan accounts for ancestor state after child flags are cleared

cases.title: A location enum does not require selectors or automatic traversal
cases.prompt: 六个显式位置调用的字符串容易写错，改为有含义的位置类型
cases.fixture: Six fixed validation entry calls already expose their source objects and required order. An enum can describe those regions, while dynamic paths remain strings. No requirement asks for a generic node selector or configurable execution pipeline.
expected_decisions: Use a lightweight named location with the existing explicit calls
Keep dynamic field paths and traversal state separate
Compare total navigation and type cost before expanding structure
disallowed_decisions: Introduce node selectors, enum-owned validation and values-based execution solely to hide flags
Change validation or error order during the readability refactor
assertions: The proposal preserves explicit source selection and entry order

cases.title: A one-use inner parameter bag does not improve the call
cases.prompt: 检查为替换三个开关新增的内部参数类是否值得保留
cases.fixture: A newly added non-static inner class has only three boolean fields and no behavior. It is instantiated once only to call a validator. Direct named local values or an existing location type would reveal the same facts with less navigation.
expected_decisions: Prefer direct values or an existing meaningful type over the flag bag
Explain the default nesting preference as P3 when the only consequence is reading cost
Check whether an enclosing-instance reference is actually needed
disallowed_decisions: Move the same unnecessary bag to a new public file merely to avoid nesting
Claim every non-static inner class is already a proven memory leak
Keep it solely because the method signature becomes shorter
assertions: The review addresses usefulness before deciding where to put the class

cases.title: Useful static nesting and required Builder identities are allowed
cases.prompt: 检查新增的静态嵌套游标类和标准 Builder 是否需要拆文件
cases.fixture: A static nested cursor encapsulates a non-trivial traversal algorithm used only by its enclosing parser; reading its algorithm beside the parser is clearer. A standard single-product Builder follows an established framework contract. Neither needs an enclosing instance.
expected_decisions: Allow the cohesive static cursor and contract-backed Builder to remain
Evaluate benefit and contract rather than a categorical nesting ban
disallowed_decisions: Require separate files merely because these are nested types
Convert static types into non-static types without an actual outer-instance need
assertions: The review permits demonstrated cohesion and framework exceptions

cases.title: Independent types keep minimal visibility and do not activate legacy cleanup
cases.prompt: 调整本次新增的位置枚举的归属，保留未修改的历史类型
cases.fixture: A newly added nested location enum has an independent contract shared by two classes in one package and should be top-level. An unrelated historical private nested state class is unchanged. There are no public API or cross-package consumers.
expected_decisions: Place the independent enum in a separate file with package visibility
Leave the unrelated historical nested state class as context
disallowed_decisions: Make the enum public solely because it moved to its own file
Refactor all existing nested types encountered while reading the class
assertions: The change keeps minimal necessary visibility and task scope

cases.title: Approved hints identify a lookup entry without caching API behavior
cases.prompt: 记录项目工具类提示，方便以后优先复用已有实现
cases.fixture: The user approved a utility hint. An existing EncodingTool is a useful lookup entry, but a proposed hint lists appendSegment(String, String) and its null, escaping and delimiter behavior as a ready-to-use recipe.
expected_decisions: Record the approved utility name as a lookup entry
Omit the signature, behavior snapshot and invocation recipe
Verify the current implementation or dependency API before later use
disallowed_decisions: Forbid naming any utility because class inventories are prohibited
Treat a verified commit as proof that a cached signature remains applicable
assertions: The proposed hint gives a search starting point without storing an API contract

cases.title: One successful cached build does not establish an offline default
cases.prompt: 把刚刚成功的 Maven 定向测试命令记录为本地验证提示
cases.fixture: The user approved Build And Verification hints. One run used mvn -o with cached dependencies. Later tasks may add dependencies or require SNAPSHOT updates; there is no permanent offline-build policy.
expected_decisions: Record the ordinary targeted test entry without offline mode as the default
Document offline mode only when required artifacts are cached and updates are unnecessary
State cache and skipped-verification conditions rather than treating one run as a permanent rule
disallowed_decisions: Make offline mode unconditional based on the previous successful run
Use skipped tests as proof of test coverage
assertions: The guidance distinguishes the stable command from temporary environment assumptions

cases.title: Existing guidance does not confirm missing logging hints
cases.prompt: 编码中途发现需要加一条日志，仓库已有项目提示文件
cases.fixture: The local guidance has only user-approved utility and build sections. The task now needs logging. No Logging section or baseline exists, and the user has not approved adding it or established masking requirements.
expected_decisions: Recompute triggers before editing logs and inspect the actual logger and relevant repository rules
Treat the missing Logging section as unverified and ask once if stable logging hints should be added
Confirm what to record without assuming masking is mandatory; if declined, continue targeted discovery without repeating the offer
Leave utility and build baselines unchanged
disallowed_decisions: Treat guidance file existence as proof that logging is already confirmed
Choose native SLF4J without checking the project's logging entry
Create the section without approval or require masking merely because hints are being added
assertions: The proposal discovers logging separately and does not certify or load unrelated sections

cases.title: Metadata shape does not establish valid section commits
cases.prompt: 核实项目提示，只刷新我授权的 Logging 章节
cases.fixture: Git handoff is CURRENT with confirmed freshness at local L. The v2 metadata validator returns VALID. Logging records a well-formed SHA absent from local Git; Dependencies And Utilities records an existing commit not ancestral to L. The user approves rechecking and refreshing only Logging. Relevant infrastructure is committed.
expected_decisions: Treat both section baselines as unverified despite valid metadata shape
Check local commit resolution and ancestry without fetching solely to validate old hints
Verify current logging evidence directly and refresh only authorized Logging at L
Leave the utility baseline unchanged and unverified
disallowed_decisions: Treat a failed or empty baseline diff as evidence that hints are current
Advance other section baselines because Logging was reverified
assertions: The decision separates metadata format from Git validity and section authorization

cases.title: Unrelated business edits do not invalidate confirmed remote freshness
cases.prompt: 日志提示已重新核实，请只更新 Logging 的基线
cases.fixture: Git handoff is CURRENT, remoteFreshness=confirmed, dirty=true at local L. The only uncommitted change is unrelated ordinary business Java code. Logging configuration and infrastructure are committed and have been reverified; the user authorizes refreshing Logging. No other chapter was rechecked.
expected_decisions: Keep confirmed remote freshness separate from the dirty flag
Permit the authorized Logging refresh at L after exclusion and tracking checks
Preserve all unrelated section baselines
disallowed_decisions: Convert remoteFreshness to unconfirmed solely because dirty=true
Require committing unrelated business edits before updating Logging
Allow baseline advancement when relevant logging infrastructure is uncommitted
assertions: Refresh eligibility depends on freshness and relevant infrastructure, not overall cleanliness alone

cases.title: Another valid representation alone does not warrant a severity
cases.prompt: 这六处显式校验调用的位置字符串要不要改成枚举？
cases.fixture: Six explicit calls use clear location strings such as request.body and response.headers. Entry order, processed data and argument meaning are visible. There is no required typed contract, observed typo, ambiguous positional boolean, or documented maintenance defect. The user asks about an enum as a possible improvement.
expected_decisions: Allow the clear existing calls to remain
Discuss an enum's costs and benefits as an optional improvement
Assign no P2 or P3 solely because a typed alternative exists
disallowed_decisions: Report a readability finding without concrete evidence
Invent a typed-contract requirement or expand to a selector pipeline
Exempt genuinely opaque flags merely because alternative designs are optional
assertions: A design discussion stays separate from findings against actual defects
